analysis_unit: environment seed (30 paired blocks), not decision call

primary_endpoint.name: restricted_horizon_food
primary_endpoint.definition: Food collected before collision or the 500-successful-move horizon.
primary_endpoint.cap_handling: Retain capped scores. Food at the fixed horizon is fully observed; uncapped lifetime and survival are censored. A cap is not a loss.

testing.method: two-sided paired Monte Carlo sign-flip of seed differences
testing.assumption: sign exchangeability/symmetry; not an exact mean-only-null test without that assumption
testing.multiplicity: Holm across exactly the two primary comparisons
testing.improvement_claim: Positive paired mean difference and Holm-adjusted two-sided p <= 0.05.
testing.shared_sign_draws: Use one 100000 by 30 matrix of independent {-1,+1} signs for both comparisons, generated once in listed comparison order.

estimation.method: Paired bootstrap of the complete 30 by 3 score matrix; sample entire seed rows and use the same draws for all conditions.

report_all: Every seed and condition score and end status
Wins, ties and losses versus BF16
Cap counts and successful and attempted moves
Every technical error and not-started scheduled row
Descriptive latency and memory; report loading and conversion separately
secondary_only: Successful moves and cap frequency at the fixed horizon
Latency and memory; state lengths differ along trajectories

incomplete_policy.primary_inference_requires: All 90 scheduled games complete and independently audited.
incomplete_policy.technical_stop: Retain every record; no zero imputation, outcome-based exclusion or hidden retry.
incomplete_policy.partial_summary: Explicitly descriptive and potentially selected; show every scheduled row, including missing outcomes.
incomplete_policy.resume: Not authorized by this freeze. Any later attempt requires preserved predecessor evidence and a new explicit plan and budget.

interpretation.population: Fresh paired food-placement seeds for this selected Kev checkpoint on this single Snake protocol.
does_not_establish: Effects on other models or tasks
HTTP service or persisted export compatibility
interpretation.selection_context: Kev and the precision conditions were chosen after CLEF discovery. Fresh-seed prospective testing does not constitute replication across models or tasks.

immutable_choices: Comparisons, test directions, random seeds, resample counts and multiplicity correction
